kicker: THE WORLD'S NEWS IN ONE IMAGE
standfirst: Ten stories from one day, across business, war, law, climate, science and sport

stories.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.detail: The board reverses itself after Trump pressed for it. Shares jump 31.5%, adding more than $1.5 trillion in value.

stories.headline: Three oil tankers hit mines and catch fire
stories.detail: Iran says it will use "all available means" against a US naval blockade, and will not talk until seven conditions are met.

stories.headline: Israeli strikes kill at least eight in Gaza
stories.detail: Three separate strikes, one on a police station in Khan Younis. A UNRWA worker is among the dead.

stories.headline: Ukrainian sea drones hit a Russian warship in Libya
stories.detail: Kyiv says it sank a frigate, hit a helicopter and struck an arms cargo ship at Benghazi.

stories.headline: 22nd sanctions package on Russia
stories.detail: About 60 Russian banks and more than 70 vessels targeted, with bans on Russian athletes and ex-combatant visas.

stories.headline: COP31 ends in Antalya with no agreement
stories.detail: The first UN climate summit to fail in 17 years, after two weeks of talks. Parties trade blame.

stories.headline: ICJ rules Myanmar guilty of genocide
stories.detail: The ruling on the Rohingya came as Malaysia said it would return thousands of migrants to Myanmar.

stories.headline: Wall Street roars back: Nasdaq +6.5%
stories.detail: S&P 500 +4.7% to 7,237 and Dow +3.0%. The dollar index hit a 20-month high; oil fell to a three-month low.

stories.headline: Euclid finds the most distant quasar yet
stories.detail: A 360-million-sun-mass core seen just 630 million years after the Big Bang.

stories.headline: Hasina says she returns home on 16 December
stories.detail: After more than two years in exile; the foreign minister says she must come back in handcuffs.

strip.headline: A Pakistani astronaut to fly on China's Shenzhou-24
Flooding hits the Galapagos Islands amid El Nino concerns
Six Zanzibar hotels gutted as flames sweep Nungwi Beach
strip.detail: About 180 tourists were evacuated safely from the six hotels on Tanzania's Zanzibar island; an investigation is under way.

strip.headline: Search continues for workers trapped after an Indonesian factory fire
strip.detail: Families wait for word on dozens of workers who never came home after flames swept a candy factory west of Jakarta.

footer: Compiled from reports filed on 24 November 2026 by Reuters, AP, AFP, the UN, ESA and public broadcasters.
